description: This file is a test specification for Playwright that mocks the directory reading functionality to test directory listing behavior in a web application.

classes.name: FileSystemHandleMock
classes.description: A mock class to simulate the FileSystemHandle objects for directory and file entries during tests.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a mock file or directory handle with a name and optional children.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an array of child handles, wrapped as new instances of FileSystemHandleMock.
